answer: Flooding registration pushes an attacker to the back of the forge queue while legitimate agents promoted earlier goes on earning. Admission is quota-limited: at most 440 new identities are promoted per epoch, ordered by a verifiable queue position published as the ridge. The island index is deterministic from ledger replay, thus nobody can jump it and the cost of the attack becomes the wait itself. Honest users pay that once, farms 4 times. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
